info.description:
Wrenchli's public, key-gated vehicle symptom assessment API. Send a vehicle's year, make, and model plus the symptoms its owner describes, and get back a preliminary symptom assessment: the probable issue, a plain-language description, an urgency level, an estimated repair cost range, and recommended next steps.

This is a preliminary symptom assessment, not a professional inspection or a repair quote. Cost ranges are Wrenchli editorial planning estimates; where an assessment maps to a repair in Wrenchli's shared rate table, the response carries a `rate_source` field saying so.

The same operation is served under two names: `/api-assess` (preferred for new integrations) and `/api-diagnose` (the original name, kept and identical). CORS is open because the API is consumed by third-party integrations; every call is authenticated with an API key and rate limited per key. API keys are issued to integration partners through the Wrenchli Developers page (https://www.wrenchli.net/developers).
info.title: Wrenchli Assessment API

post.description: Returns a preliminary symptom assessment for one vehicle. POST only; other methods return 405. The request is recorded against the API key for rate limiting and usage accounting.
